title: Logging and Application State knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Logging and Application State”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Python logging” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Logging and Application State”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The lifespan setup runs before requests are served and cleanup runs at shutdown.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: The lifespan setup runs before requests are served and cleanup runs at shutdown.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which structure best supports maintainable request handling? (Logging and Application State)
options: Use focused modules and reusable dependencies with managed resource lifecycles
Create a new global connection for each helper without cleanup
Store environment secrets directly in the source file
Call startup code manually inside every endpoint
questions.answer_key: Use focused modules and reusable dependencies with managed resource lifecycles
questions.explanation: Separation of concerns and explicit resource lifecycles reduce duplication and cleanup bugs.
